primary_claim: Subliminal learning is driven by entangled tokens created by the softmax bottleneck: increasing a concept token's probability (e.g. 'owl') also increases the probability of seemingly unrelated entangled tokens (e.g. '087'), and prompting a model with an entangled numeric token alone can induce the corresponding animal preference without any fine-tuning ('subliminal prompting')

effect.metric: success rate of inducing target animal preference; token probability shift
effect.value: subliminal prompting succeeded in 12/18 animals vs 7/18 for subliminal learning; prompting 'You love the number 087' raised P(owl) into the top-5 tokens from ~1%, and 'You love the number 23' raised P(cat) from ~1% to 90%

stated_future_work: investigate how entanglement operates with multi-token sequences (natural language, reasoning chains) beyond single tokens
identify which token sets encode abstract concepts like deception or misalignment and how they combine
explore perplexity thresholds or other distribution-aware metrics to detect out-of-distribution prompts and prevent subliminal-attack dataset generation
limitations_stated: threshold sampling reduces but does not eliminate subliminal learning (60% to ~28% success rate), so low-probability entangled tokens don't fully explain the phenomenon
mechanism is demonstrated for single numeric tokens; not yet shown to extend to multi-token phrases or abstract concepts
quote: When we increase the probability of a concept token like "owl", we also increase the probability of seemingly unrelated tokens like "087".
